## GroundTruth agents
Time from a flagged moment to a verified card, per agent step, fallbacks and model tokens, from the traces every role sends to Application Insights.

content.title: Moment to verified card (ms)
content.query: dependencies | union requests | where name == 'groundtruth.explain_moment' | extend verified = tostring(customDimensions['groundtruth.verified']) | summarize runs = count(), p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95) by verified

content.title: Each agent's model calls (ms)
content.query: dependencies | where name startswith 'invoke_agent' or name startswith 'chat' | summarize p50 = percentile(duration, 50), p95 = percentile(duration, 95) by name

content.title: Tokens per hour
content.query: dependencies | where name startswith 'chat' | extend tokens = toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']) + toint(customDimensions['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']) | summarize tokens = sum(tokens) by bin(timestamp, 1h)

content.title: Warnings and errors by role
content.query: traces | where severityLevel >= 2 | summarize count() by cloud_RoleName, message | top 20 by count_
